copyCmdTooltip: Copy companion prompt for your Agent to push live task progress here
copyPromptText: During my upcoming coding tasks, call the deskbox MCP tool deskbox_push_widget_data (widgetId: "agent-hud") to stream your live stage progress to my desktop "AI Progress HUD" (update state: agentName, taskTitle, statusText, stepLabel, progress(0-100), isBusy(true/false), and prepend stage events {tag, tone, text, timeText} to the events collection; when done, set progress to "100" and isBusy to "false"). If deskbox MCP tools are not loaded in this session yet, remind me to restart the client or use the CLI: DeskBox.exe widget push --id agent-hud --set statusText="Running" --set taskTitle="Building project" --set progress=65 --set isBusy=true --prepend "events:tag=BUILD;tone=accent;text=Compiled module"
